candidates.title: Feature Request: exact chunked training for long windows (chunk x window memory, gradient carried through the cached K/V and recurrent state)
candidates.snippet: ### What  Training on a long window builds explicit attention (flash attention has no backward), so the KQ matrix is window² × heads floats per layer. At 63k tokens on a 27B (24 heads) that's the allocation we measured: `cudaMalloc` asked for **388,718 MiB**. Recompute can't help, since it's one layer's working set. candidates.title: Feature Request: backward ops to fine-tune hybrid gated delta-net models (GATED_DELTA_NET, CONCAT, SSM_CONV, L2_NORM, SIGMOID)
candidates.snippet: ### What  Hybrid models that mix attention with a gated delta-net (Qwen3.5, Qwen3-Next, and the delta-net family generally) can't be fine-tuned with `llama_opt_epoch`: the training graph meets ops with no backward rule. In our runs those were `GATED_DELTA_NET`, `CONCAT` (the conv state joined to the ubatch's qkv), `SSM_CONV`, `L2_NORM` and `SIGMOID` (the gated output). candidates.title: Feature Request: CUDA OUT_PROD with a quantized src0 (LoRA training through a quantized base on NVIDIA)
candidates.snippet: ### What  The CUDA `OUT_PROD` kernel takes F32 `src0` only (#26599 adds F16). In a LoRA training graph over a quantized base, the backward through every frozen quantized weight is an `OUT_PROD` with that weight as `src0`, so on CUDA such a graph either falls back to the CPU or needs an F32 copy of the base.
